description: This file defines the exported API of a Certificate Management DLL, including functions for initialization, certificate handling, verification, request creation, and encoding. It provides interface declarations for certificate operations in a Windows environment.

methods.name: ALCertInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the certificate DLL with user context.

methods.name: ALCertUnload
methods.description: Unloads and cleans up the certificate context.

methods.name: ALCertAddTrustedCA
methods.description: Adds a trusted CA certificate to the context.

methods.name: ALCertAddSubject
methods.description: Adds a subject certificate with private key to the context.

methods.name: ALCertRemoveTrustedCA
methods.description: Removes a trusted CA certificate.

methods.name: ALCertRemoveSubject
methods.description: Removes a subject certificate.

methods.name: ALCertAddCRL
methods.description: Adds a Certificate Revocation List.

methods.name: ALCertRemoveCRL
methods.description: Removes a CRL.

methods.name: ALCertGetCRLNextUpdateTime
methods.description: Retrieves the next update time for CRL.

methods.name: ALCertVerify
methods.description: Verifies a certificate chain.

methods.name: ALCertAcquireCertInformation
methods.description: Extracts internal information from a certificate.

methods.name: ALCertExtractCommonNameFromDN
methods.description: Extracts the common name from a distinguished name.

methods.name: ALCertAcquireCertificationPath
methods.description: Gets a certification path for a certificate.

methods.name: ALCertAcquireCertificateUnit
methods.description: Gets a certificate unit from the path.

methods.name: ALCertAcquireCertificateUnitByHandle
methods.description: Gets certificate unit by handle.

methods.name: ALCertGetKeyTypeByHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the key type of a certificate.

methods.name: ALCertAcquireIDByHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the subject ID from a certificate handle.

methods.name: ALCertAcquireCANameByHandle
methods.description: Gets CA name info from a certificate handle.

methods.name: ALCertAddPKIServer
methods.description: Adds a PKI server configuration.

methods.name: ALCertImportPKIServer
methods.description: Imports PKI server info from encoding.

methods.name: ALCertRemovePKIServer
methods.description: Removes a PKI server configuration.

methods.name: ALCertRetrievePKIServerCert
methods.description: Retrieves certificate and key data from PKI server.

methods.name: ALCertSignPKIClient
methods.description: Signs a PKI client request.

methods.name: ALCertCreateEntity
methods.description: Creates a certificate entity with attributes.

methods.name: ALCertCreatePKCS10CertificateRequest
methods.description: Creates an encoded PKCS#10 certificate signing request.

methods.name: ALCertGetPrivateKeyInfo
methods.description: Extracts private key info from a certificate handle.

methods.name: ALCertSetIssuedCertificate
methods.description: Associates an issued certificate with a subject handle.

methods.name: ALCertSetIssuedPKCS7CertChain
methods.description: Sets an issued PKCS#7 certificate chain for a subject.

methods.name: ALCertIsKeyMatchable
methods.description: Checks if the key matches the request (matches private key to public key).

methods.name: ALCertMime64Encoding
methods.description: Encodes binary data to Base64.

methods.name: ALCertMime64Decoding
methods.description: Decodes Base64 data to binary.

ctags.name: InstallationPathName
ctags.pattern: /^    LPSTR       InstallationPathName;               \/* path name of the VPCom installation dire/

ctags.name: bServer
ctags.pattern: /^    BOOLEAN     bServer;                            \/* it's TRUE for certification authority; F/

ctags.name: hCertContext
ctags.pattern: /^    AL_HANDLE   hCertContext;                       \/* hold the context memory block for Cisco /

ctags.name: hUserContext
ctags.pattern: /^    AL_HANDLE   hUserContext;                       \/* opaque handle passed by SAKM or whatever/
